evidence.quote: The courses in the International Business Administration & Entrepreneurship programme are held exclusively in English.
You do not have to pay tuition fees. You only have to pay a semester contribution of approx. 450 EUR per semester (subject to change).
Documents* you need for your application: University entrance qualification

notes: tuition: the two quotes state there are no tuition fees; a semester contribution (approx. 450–484 EUR) is separate. teachingLanguages: English only. applicationChannel: DAAD page states the application is submitted via uni-assist; however the Leuphana pages say foreign applicants should check whether they apply directly or via uni-assist, so this is kept as a manual_check as well.

note.fr: Les candidats de pays non-UE/EEE doivent d'abord faire vérifier leur certificat étranger par uni-assist (voir la page « Non-EU/EEA certificates »).
note.en: Non-EU/EEA applicants must first have their foreign certificate checked by uni-assist (see the 'Non-EU/EEA certificates' page).

evidence.quote: If you have a foreign university entrance qualification, please refer to the chart to see whether you are applying directly to Leuphana University Lüneburg or whether you are applying to Uni-Assist.
